text:
Asha: heads up team: we're kicking off a coordinated rollout for router/runtime/api/console in ~12m. plan is a staged anneal 0->25->60->100 over ~30m with staggered service order to limit blast radius.
Ben: what versions are we promoting?
Asha: router=4.1.2 runtime=2.9.0 api=3.13.0 console=1.10.0 (all pinned in orchestrator). release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/lockstep-2026-03-21-draft
Riley: adding rollback thresholds: router 5xx >0.25% for 3m or api error rate >0.5% sustained 5m -> freeze + rollback. Also set p95 latency jump >50% -> pause and investigate.
Asha: agree. deploy-bot, please include these thresholds in the wave metadata and post preflight to #eng-sre.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight starting: checking image sigs, cluster health, pinned variant validity. will publish preflight report in 8m. wave=lk-2026-03-21-b
Jordan: quick note on order: router -> runtime -> api -> console (same as usual) but add 2m spacing between groups. keeps routing stable.
Asha: runbook snippets I'm adding now:
```
# smoke_checks.sh
curl -fsS https://api.redwood.internal/health || exit 2
curl -fsS https://router.redwood.internal/health || exit 2
# validate console UI endpoint
curl -fsS https://console.internal/_status || exit 2
```
Riley: good. also add KV smoke: runtime-admin kv-stats | grep "active"
Ben: oncall is @oncall-sre for this window. please ping if anything trips.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight OK -> report: https://internal.reports/lk-2026-03-21-b/preflight :white_check_mark:
Asha: starting rollout in 10m. will watch router dashboards. everyone standby for 25% checkpoint.
Jordan: enabling extra trace sampling during anneal (50%). set alerts: router_5xx_rate(0.25%), api_error_rate(0.5%), runtime_kv_eviction(10/min).
Riley: adding a quick mitigation: if router p95 >2x baseline but error <threshold, shift back to 40% and hold while we inspect.
Asha: noted. deploy-bot begin step: router -> launching new pods (replicas=30).
Asha: 25% traffic shift scheduled at +9m.
Ben: pre-announce to customers via status-banner? not necessary, internal only.
Jordan: router smoke green, 5xx 0.01%, p95 flat. warming KV cache shows hit-rate 92%.
Riley: runtime deploy started. warming threads, warming kv caches.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] traffic update: 25% routed to new variants.
Asha: api deploy queued until runtime hits 60% anneal.
Jordan: runtime p95 +10% compared to baseline, no errors. proceeding.
Riley: running quick quality replay for 50 critical prompts, outputs look consistent.
Asha: shifting api to 25%.
Ben: api smoke: /v1/health OK, response codes nominal.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] progressive anneal: moving to 60% in 8m.
Jordan: console deploy started but feature flag for new-dashboard OFF so no front-end risk.
Riley: small api p95 bump at +22m, +18% but error rate unchanged. monitoring.
Asha: decision call: continue to 100% in 10m if no errors. any objections?
Ben: none from me. oncall-sre: I'll be on watch for the final anneal. ping on any anomaly.
Asha: final anneal to 100% in 10m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout complete -> 100% traffic to new variants. wave=lk-2026-03-21-b :tada:
Jordan: all services stable after 20m. router 5xx 0.02%, api errors 0.08%, runtime eviction low.
Riley: post-deploy evals running. will post token-level cost comparison and latency delta after 1h.
Asha: publishing release note summary and linking the runbook, rollback tags, and perf caveats.
Ben: rollback tags confirmed: router=4.1.1 runtime=2.8.9 api=3.12.8 console=1.9.9
oncall-sre: If any late regressions show up, ping me directly (oncall-sre) and we'll trigger rollback.
Asha: nice work team 389. closing thread and archiving wave artifacts.
